title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
summary: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no longer appears on the commercial terms page: … Meta may use any content from such
reason: Meta's change to its terms of service about AI training data is not a model release, research artifact, business event (financing/M&A/partnership/product launch), government policy action, or OSS tool release; no active rule covers it.
